data.body: Resolved by duplicate d284-0454-596a-46c1 (same defect: shared `.tmp-<digest>.json` collision in `sizing.py::save_checkpoint`). Fix LANDED via Gerrit change 2334, commit f135b84d1188 (MERGED), closed plan_defect caused_by 5fd2-a7c2-0aec-48fa. Linked `d284 duplicates 6485`. This ticket can be closed as a duplicate by a human operator — I did not close it myself because no commit carries a 6485 trailer, so the completion-verifier close precheck would require a --force override (prohibited for agents).
